address_local.description: Street address in the local language as the venue's official source writes it (building and floor allowed), for a taxi driver; shown under the local name with a big-print 給司機看 sheet. Never from Google Places (its terms forbid storing formattedAddress).

address_source.description: URL of the official source the address_local was read from.

district_query.description: Optional geocode string for the district when claimed_district (the readable name the deliverable shows and links with) does not resolve to the right place, e.g. '堺町（小樽市）' for '小樽市堺町'. source_verify_run geocodes with this; a centroid whose display_name does not name the district is refused (TW-092).

business_status.description: Optional sourced operating signal (Google Places businessStatus vocabulary) recorded during research; source-verify enforces it at Gate 0. (P1) The bare-string form is retained for back-compat but is SELF-ATTESTED: verify.py's Gate 0 treats it as unauditable and never lets it pass, regardless of value — a candidate can only clear Gate 0 with the object form, {status, source_url, as_of}, mirroring verified-pois.schema.json's own business_status shape so a candidate's sourced signal survives into the verified artifact unchanged. (TW-068 fix round 1: TW-063's fix deferred widening this on the grounds that nothing exercised the gap; scripts/source_verify_run.py now does, so every schema-valid candidates.yaml can reach Gate 0.)

intro.description: Sourced one-paragraph introduction for the reader (v1.0 §4.3). Absent = the reader shows no intro line.

opens_at.description: When reservations open (v1.0 §4.7); a referenced POI with this set must have a hard-dated 預約 checklist item.

site.description: 中文網站名 (v1.0 §4.2); copied into verified-pois by source_verify_run.

site_local.description: Original-language site name, for a non-zh source.
